$comment: Build manifest consumed by .github/workflows/build-and-push.yml. Add a new OCS release as a new entry, then push a git tag equal to its `version` (e.g. 3.0.0-rc2) to build & publish ONLY that version, tagged `:<version>` (editing this file alone does not build). Optional per-version keys: backend_extra_build_apt, backend_extra_runtime_apt, backend_extra_pip (extra packages); backend_dockerfile, frontend_dockerfile (custom Dockerfile filename relative to the build context, last resort). Source patches need no config: drop them in backend/patches/<ref>/ or frontend/patches/<ref>/. See docs developer/releasing.
